jobs.occupation: Become a Butcher in Wholesale – Quality Meat Processing in Aartselaar
jobs.description:
As a butcher in our wholesale department, you are responsible for expertly processing quality meat for professional customers in Belgium and abroad. You work precisely and efficiently in a modern production environment where craftsmanship is key. Your duties include deboning, cutting, and portioning beef, pork, lamb, and poultry to the specified weights and customer requirements. You also prepare ground meats and charcuterie, conduct quality checks, and ensure products are packaged and labeled correctly.

A typical workday starts early in the morning. You begin at 6:00 am with your close-knit team. Your responsibilities include deboning, cutting, and weighing meat, always paying attention to detail and quality. You follow strict procedures to guarantee food safety and contribute to a smooth production flow. During lunch, you and your colleagues enjoy our house-made meat products, and you finish your workday by 2:00 pm.

Are you a skilled professional who likes to roll up your sleeves and is committed to quality? Apply today and join our team of passionate butchers!

• Thorough knowledge of the complete breakdown and deboning of a beef carcass (very important)

• Skilled at cutting to weight and deboning meat

• Precise and efficient work ethic with a keen eye for detail and quality

• Motivated, reliable, and takes initiative

• Able to work independently and as part of a team

• Good command of English and willing to learn Dutch

• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays if needed

• Completed lower or higher secondary education

• At least 2 years of experience as a butcher (5–10 years or more is a plus)

Dive into a dynamic role where your skills in mechanical assembly will keep everything in its rightful place. As a Pre-Assembly Worker, you’ll be responsible for the meticulous assembly and disassembly of tooling on our state-of-the-art roll forming lines. Your day will involve transporting and maintaining tooling, ensuring a clean and safe workspace, and reporting any repairs or improvements needed. If you thrive in a detail-oriented environment and are eager to learn, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

A typical day sees you inspecting your own work for precision, collaborating with team members, and operating both conventional and CNC-controlled machines. You’ll ensure that every piece meets our high standards of quality and accuracy. This role requires independent work, flexibility, and a keen eye for detail, making sure every component fits perfectly.

Ready to take the next step in your career? Apply now and join a team where your contributions will make a real impact. Click the apply button and start your journey with us today!

• Education in mechanics or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Eagerness to learn, conscientiousness, and sense of responsibility

• Ability to work independently and safely

• Flexibility and willingness to work in a 2-shift system

• Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality, order, and cleanliness

• Technical background or equivalent experience

We are currently looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist, fluent in French and English, to join a team based in Brussels.

In this temporary assignment, you will play a key role in supporting the full recruitment cycle within the professional services sector. Your responsibilities will include sourcing talent, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and ensuring an efficient and positive hiring process.

Client Details

A professional services organisation based in Brussels.

Description

As a recruiter your responsibilities are:

 

• Source and attract candidates using various recruitment channels.
• Screen and shortlist applicants based on job requirements.
• Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers.
• Maintain and update recruitment databases and records.
• Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Provide support in contract preparation and onboarding processes.
• Collaborate with the HR team to meet recruitment goals.
• Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and procedures

• Bilingual in French and English (mandatory)
• Previous experience in recruitment is required
• Enjoys daily interaction with people while also appreciating administrative tasks
• Available immediately
• Temporary contract, with a potential opportunity for a permanent position

Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands. We welcome applications from candidates across the EU who are willing to relocate to Maastricht for this opportunity.

 Are you an experienced manufacturing professional with a background in cell therapy and GMP? Would you like to play a key role in producing advanced therapies that have a direct impact on patients' lives? Then this position as Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician could be the perfect next step in your career.
 
 Job Description
 You will become part of an international pharmaceutical organization, focused on advanced cell and gene therapies. Working in a state-of-the-art GMP cleanroom, you will contribute to the manufacturing of innovative medicines while receiving comprehensive onboarding and continuous training. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your technical expertise within a fast-growing and highly regulated industry.
 As a Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician, your responsibilities include:

• Executing manufacturing activities in a GMP-compliant cleanroom using aseptic techniques
• Performing cell culture processes, including media preparation, cell expansion, and harvesting
• Accurately completing batch records and manufacturing documentation
• Identifying, documenting, and reporting deviations while supporting quality investigations
• Maintaining high standards of GMP compliance, quality, and safety
• Contributing to process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives
• Working in a 6-shift schedule, including evenings, nights, and weekends
Profile

• MBO or HBO degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline
• Minimum of 2 years of experience in GMP manufacturing, preferably within cell therapy, ATMP, or biopharmaceutical production
• Experience working in a cleanroom environment using aseptic techniques
• Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused mindset
• Good communication skills in English
• A collaborative and proactive approach to teamwork
• Willingness to work in a 5-shift rotation
Please note: This position is intended for manufacturing professionals. Candidates with a PhD are not eligible for this vacancy and will not be considered.

 Employment Conditions

• Salary: €3,000 - €4,000 gross per month, depending on experience, plus 27% shift allowance
• Initial 12-month contract with the intention of permanent employment
• Extensive onboarding and GMP training programme
• The organization offers excellent long-term career prospects and opportunities for professional growth.
• Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands
• Vacancy number: 27390
Important Notice
 Only candidates who already hold a valid EU work permit or have unrestricted authorization to work within the European Union are eligible to apply.
 Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Applications from candidates who require sponsorship or who do not meet the work authorization requirements will not be considered

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Product Owner
jobs.description:

What do WE expect from our Consultant ?

• You have at least 2 years of experience as a Product Owner

• You have a good knowledge of the Agile methodologies

• You have good organizational and communicational skills

• You are fluent in French or Dutch (Bonus: with good knowledge of the other one) and English

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

A high-quality food company that delivers fresh products daily to hospitality clients and large-scale kitchens. The 300 employees work together day after day to make this possible. This market leader not only takes care of its customers, but also of its employees. Quality always comes first, which is why regular training is provided.

What does your working day look like as a Frozen Warehouse Worker?

 
• 
Restocking the frozen storage areas: you place incoming goods in the correct locations according to the warehouse layout

 
• 
You work with a handheld scanner that registers all movements

 
• 
You pick the correct goods and prepare them for transport, based on customer orders

 
• 
You perform accurate picking tasks by selecting the right products and efficiently preparing them for shipment

 
• 
You work according to a fixed schedule: Monday to Thursday from 12:00 PM to 9:30 PM, and Sunday from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM. This gives you a fixed schedule every week

Who are we looking for as a Frozen Warehouse Worker?

Physically fit: you can comfortably lift boxes weighing up to 20 kg

You are comfortable working in a frozen environment and can work effectively in temperatures as low as -25°C while wearing appropriate protective clothing

 
• 
Experience in logistics or as a warehouse worker is a plus

 
• 
You pay close attention to quality

 
• 
You communicate good in Dutch or English to correctly follow up on order forms

As an Inventory Planner Natural Foods, you play a key role in ensuring the right stock is available at the right time. By working closely with production, suppliers, and sales, you help achieve an optimal balance between availability and costs. With your proactive approach, you contribute to a smooth supply chain and sustainable results.
 

Job description
 
 

• Managing and creating purchase orders for production plants, co‑manufacturers, and suppliers based on aligned planning with the demand planning teams. 

• Monitoring and analysing inventory levels to ensure optimal availability and service levels. 

• Proactively communicating about supply and expiry risks and contributing to the implementation of robust inventory management processes and best practices. 

• Aligning with internal production and supply chain teams to follow up on production plans and to identify and mitigate potential supply risks in a timely manner. 

• Monitoring production and transportation flows and ensuring accurate and up‑to‑date data in SAP. 

• Continuously improving and further automating the replenishment process, including optimisation of planning parameters. 

Profile
 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a business‑related field. 

• You have at least one to two years of experience in supply chain planning, preferably in an FMCG or retail environment, and are familiar with working in a logistics‑ or transport‑oriented customer service setting; knowledge of SAP is a plus. 

• You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English and collaborate smoothly with various internal departments. 

• You work independently and proactively, with a strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. 

• You are able to set priorities and work efficiently in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

•

About the Role
 

We are looking for a versatile and reliable Administrative & Finance Support Officer to join our Finance & Administration team.
 

This is not a role for an accounting specialist, nor are we searching for the next CFO of the group. Instead, we are looking for a well-organized administrative professional who is comfortable with numbers, has a practical mindset, and enjoys bringing structure and order to daily operations.
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 
 
• Processing and monitoring bank statements 
 
• Managing and reviewing expense reports 
 
• Verifying and following up on supplier invoices 
 
• Updating Excel files and internal databases 
 
• Document management and filing 
 
• Providing general administrative support to the Finance & Administration department 
 
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of administrative processes 

Your Profile
 
 
 
• Previous experience in an administrative, back-office, or financial support role 
 
• Experience working with an ERP system or integrated business software is a strong asset 
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Teams 
 
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills 
 
• Reliable and trustworthy professional attitude 
 
• Ability to work independently 
 
• Practical mindset and willingness to build a long-term career within the company 
 

We also appreciate people who ask questions when they don't know something rather than allowing the problem to mature quietly in their inbox.
 

 
 

Language Skills
 
 
 
• Good professional command of French and/or Dutch 
 
• Practical knowledge of English, allowing you to communicate by email, phone, and Microsoft Teams in a professional environment 
 
• Willingness to further develop your English skills as part of the role 
 

Being trilingual is certainly an advantage, but we are not necessarily looking for a simultaneous interpreter for the European Commission.

By 2027, the company aims to have 300+ employees working on 25 000 unique packaging assignments. Working in this company means working in a respectful environment, where a great bond between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

As a Quality Controller, you work closely with the quality and production teams to ensure that our products not only meet the strictest standards, but also end up on store shelves with pride.

 
• 
80% inspections on the workfloor/production <> 20% desk work (registration/documentation of performed checks)

 
• 
Visual inspections of packaging and labeling

 
• 
Monitoring quality standards and improving them where possible

 
• 
Providing support during audits or certifications (BRC, IFS, Organic, customer audits...)

 
• 
Coaching among employees to strengthen quality awareness

Does reading this set of responsibilities already spark your interest? Read on and find out what we expect from you:

 
• 
A bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience in a food production environment

 
• 
Experience with BRC and IFS standards

 
• 
A good knowledge of Dutch and English, allowing you to communicate smoothly with colleagues

 
• 
You have a critical mindset and a strong eye for detail

 
• 
Your insights and observations contribute to maintaining and improving the quality level of our products

 
• 
You are willing to work in a cold environment (5–10 °C), including about half an hour per day performing checks in the freezer (-18 °C)

 
• 
You are comfortable working with MS Office and Outlook

This Belgian manufacturer of dry powder mixtures for the construction industry (mortars, adhesives, plasters, etc.), located in the Port of Antwerp, is looking to strengthen its current team with a motivated OPERATOR.

As an OPERATOR, you will be responsible for all operational tasks required during your shift for production and loading activities. You will play a crucial role in the production process and will be widely deployable across various production lines, from mixing processes to bagging.

Your responsibilities as an OPERATOR* will include:

• Preparing, weighing and accurately dosing raw materials and additives for mixing processes, particularly liquids.
• Monitoring and operating mixing and filling machines, such as dissolvers, mixing tanks and filling equipment.
• Operating, converting and setting up bagging machines.
• Setting up and loading packaging materials (e.g. film) onto the machines.
• Carrying out process checks and visual inspections of the finished product, such as checking viscosity and colour consistency.
• Replacing simple mechanical components on the production lines.
• Processing residual product and cleaning the factory, including cleaning mixing equipment and pipelines.
• Assisting drivers during loading operations.
• Carrying out internal transport and logistical activities using a forklift and/or reach truck.

REF:MEC1

Experience & Profile

• You have proven relevant work experience as an OPERATOR in a production environment.
• Experience with mixing, dispersing or filling liquids, or operating bagging and packaging machines, is preferred.
• A valid forklift and/or reach truck certificate is a major advantage.
• You are familiar with terminology and techniques used in the mixing industry, such as batch production, dosing and basic quality control
• You have a technical aptitude and a strong problem-solving mindset.
• You are communicative and have a good command of Dutch or English
